svg.title: Encore
svg.desc: The word ENCORE drawn as a formation of luminous drone dots using Encore's own formation font. In the letter O two drones are lost; their slots show as vacant rings and a neighbouring drone flies in to claim one.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
